parameters.name: messages
parameters.value:
=[{"role":"user","content":"You are a senior DevOps engineer writing a weekly developer summary. Write a concise but comprehensive weekly narrative summary for this GitHub repository activity.

Repository: {{ $json.repo }}
Period: {{ $json.period.start }} to {{ $json.period.end }}

Activity:
- {{ $json.commits_count }} commits
- {{ $json.issues_count }} closed issues
- {{ $json.prs_count }} merged PRs

Commit highlights:
{{ $json.commits.map(c => `- \`\${c.sha}\`: \${c.message}\` (by \${c.author})`).join('
') }}

Closed issues:
{{ $json.issues.map(i => `- #\${i.number}: \${i.title}`).join('
') }}

Merged PRs:
{{ $json.prs.map(pr => `- #\${pr.number}: \${pr.title}`).join('
') }}

Write in {{ $env.LANGUAGE || 'English' }}. Tone: professional, technical, concise. 200-400 words max. Format with markdown headings.

Include:
1. Executive summary (1-2 sentences)
2. Key achievements this week
3. Notable commits and their impact
4. Issue resolution highlights
5. PR merge summary
6. Looking ahead (1-2 sentences)

IMPORTANT: Return ONLY the summary text, no additional commentary or meta-text."}]

nodes.notes: Calls Claude API to generate the narrative summary

nodes.notes: Extracts the actual summary text from Claude's response

nodes.notes: Sends the summary to Discord via webhook

nodes.notes: Sends the summary via email as backup channel
